design_rationale: The study states that patients were randomly assigned to three treatment groups ('Hastalar rastgele üç gruba ayrıldı' / 'The patients were randomly assigned to three groups').

domain_judgments.rationale: The text states patients were randomly assigned to three groups, but does not describe the method of sequence generation or allocation concealment.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Hastalar rastgele üç gruba ayrıldı. Bir gruba antibiyotik (20 hasta, ampicillin/sulbaktam, 25 mg/kg), bir gruba antibiyotik ile birlikte intranazal budesonid (20 hasta, 200 mcg/gün) verilirken, kontrol grubu (22 hasta) tedavisiz izlendi.

domain_judgments.rationale: The study was open-label without blinding or placebo controls, and adherence to the 8-week medication regimens was not monitored or reported.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Grup 1'de (n=20) yalnızca antibiyotik (ampisilin/sulbaktam 25 mg/kg/gün, oral, günde iki kez) tedavisi uygulandı. Grup 2'de (n=20) aynı antibiyotik tedavisine ek olarak intranazal budesonid sprey (200 mcg/gün, günde iki kez) uygulandı. Bu iki grupta tedavi sekiz hafta sürdürüldü. Grup 3 (n=22) ise, kontrol grubu olarak tedavisiz izlendi.

domain_judgments.rationale: Outcome data were reported for all 62 enrolled patients and all 113 affected ears at both week 4 and week 8 follow-up points without any dropouts or missing data.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Grup 1'deki hastaların 17'sinde çift, üçünde tek taraflı (toplam 37 kulak) EOM vardı... Grup 2'de 16 olguda çift taraflı, dördünde ise tek taraflı olmak üzere toplam 36 kulakta EOM belirlendi... Tedavi uygulanmayan kontrol grubunda ise 18 hastada çift taraflı, dört hastada tek taraflı EOM vardı.

domain_judgments.rationale: Outcome assessment included otoscopic examination alongside tympanometry, and it was not stated whether outcome assessors were blinded to treatment group assignment.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Hastaların ilk kronik EOM tanısı aldıkları andaki ve tanıdan sonraki dördüncü ve sekizinci haftalardaki otoskopik muayene ve timpanogramları (Interacoustics Impedance Audiometer AZ 26, Denmark) yaparak sonuçlar değerlendirildi. Otoskopik muayenelerde zarın rengi, hareketi, retraksiyon ve damarlanma durumu değerlendirildi. Pnömotik otoskopide zar hareketinin ve timpanogramda tip A eğrisinin (orta kulak basıncının -100 mmH2O ve üstü, gradient >0.15 olması) izlenmesi EOM'ın iyileşmesi olarak kabul edildi.

domain_judgments.rationale: There is no mention of a pre-registered trial protocol or pre-specified statistical analysis plan.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Dördüncü ve sekizinci haftalarda, gruplar arasındaki iyileşme oranlarının istatistiksel karşılaştırılmasında "Fisher's exact test" kullanıldı.

design_rationale: Participants were randomly assigned to one of four parallel treatment groups using computer-generated block randomization.

domain_judgments.rationale: Although computer-generated random numbers and block randomization were used, the method of allocation concealment (e.g., sequentially numbered opaque sealed envelopes or central allocation) was not explicitly described.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: The children who fulfilled the selection criteria were randomly divided into four parallel groups by block randomization, with blocks of four by a resident not involved in the study. The blocks were generated randomly by an author, who was not directly involved in treatment of patient, according to computer generated random numbers.

domain_judgments.rationale: Although participants were aware of the assigned treatments due to differing modalities, interventions followed prescribed protocols without reported deviations, and all 40 randomized participants in each group were analyzed as assigned.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Children were re-evaluated with clinical examination including otoscopy and tympanometry during follow-up by consultant otolaryngologist who were not aware whether the children were subjected to study.

domain_judgments.rationale: Outcome data were available and reported for all 160 randomized participants (40 per group) with no apparent attrition.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Telephone calls were made every week to reduce the loss of follow-up... There were a total of 160 participants in the study divided equally into four groups, thus each group consisting of 40 children... Improvement of the OME status in various study groups is presented in Table 2.

domain_judgments.rationale: Outcome assessment was based on objective tympanometry curves and evaluated by otolaryngologists who were blinded to the study interventions.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Children were re-evaluated with clinical examination including otoscopy and tympanometry during follow-up by consultant otolaryngologist who were not aware whether the children were subjected to study. Children with A, As, or C curve were labelled as improved whereas those with B curve were considered to have persistent OME.

domain_judgments.rationale: The trial was prospectively registered in ClinicalTrials.gov and the reported primary outcome (improvement in OME by tympanometry) aligns with the prespecified objective and measurement approach.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: It was registered in the clinical trial registry (https://clinicaltrials.gov/show/NCT03590912).

overall_summary: The overall risk of bias is judged as some concerns due to lack of explicit information regarding allocation concealment in the randomization process, although outcome measurement, data completeness, and trial reporting were well conducted.

design_rationale: The study is described as a randomized controlled trial where participants were randomly assigned to three groups (montelukast, mometasone, and control).

domain_judgments.rationale: The paper mentions that participants were randomly assigned, but no details are provided regarding the method of sequence generation or allocation concealment.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Participants were randomly assigned into three groups.

domain_judgments.rationale: The study was open-label without blinding of participants or personnel (control received no treatment), but there is no clear evidence of deviations from the intended intervention that arose because of the trial context.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: The third group received no treatment. One of the treatments of OME is waiting treatment. Therefore, receiving no medication in the control group is not unethical.

domain_judgments.rationale: Outcome data were available for all 143 randomized participants with zero lost to follow-up.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Lost to follow-up give reasons n=0 Discontinued intervention give reasons n=0

domain_judgments.rationale: Although tympanometry provides objective data, categorization into complete, partial, or no improvement by evaluating physicians was likely unblinded, which introduces some concerns of bias.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: All patients had undergone tympanometry at the start of study and after one month to confirm the OME and to evaluate the response to treatment. Patients in each group were divided into complete improvement, partial improvement, and no improvement patients. All patients were evaluated by a physician for assessment of treatment response after one month, and the data were recorded.

domain_judgments.rationale: While a trial registration is reported, detailed pre-specified analysis intentions and outcome measurement protocols are insufficient to rule out selective reporting.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: This study is registered at ClinicalTrials.gov with ClinicalTrials.gov Identifier: NCT02541760.

overall_summary: The study has some concerns overall due to lack of reporting on sequence generation and allocation concealment, an unblinded open-label design, and lack of clarity on blinding of outcome assessors.

design_rationale: Participants were randomly allocated to the treatment and control groups using a random number table.

domain_judgments.rationale: A random number table was used for sequence generation, but there is no information on allocation concealment, and some post-randomization exclusions occurred.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: The arrangement of cases in the case or control group was performed using random number table.

domain_judgments.rationale: The study was single-blinded without a placebo spray in the control group, meaning participants and carers were aware of assigned intervention, which could lead to deviations or co-interventions.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: We arranged a single blinded randomized clinical trial... We administered a period of amoxicillin and a decongestant for both group and nasal beclomethasone spray only for case group.

domain_judgments.rationale: Fourteen of 106 randomized participants were excluded during the study without a breakdown by intervention group or reasons per arm, raising potential concerns for attrition bias.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: During the study, 14 subjects were excluded because of the presence of the exclusion criteria. Finally we completed our data with 92 patients; 46 subjects in each group.

domain_judgments.rationale: Subjective outcomes (symptom improvement) were reported by unblinded parents/patients, and otoscopic examinations were conducted by the research team without reported blinding, likely influencing outcome assessment.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: After 4 weeks, all subjects in both groups underwent a 2nd otoscopic exam and tympanometry, and any improvement or worsening of complaints was directly asked from them and/or their parents. The research team filled all questionnaires and controlled all otoscopies during this process. All of tympanometries were performed by an expert audiologist.

domain_judgments.rationale: There is no evidence of a pre-registered trial protocol or pre-specified statistical analysis plan, leaving potential for selective reporting among multiple outcome measures.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: According to our analyzer, chi-square test was arranged for data of improvement by parents, while a Wilcoxon test was considered to analyze data of otoscopic tympanic examinations before and after treatment. Lastly, we analyzed our results in tympanometries with Mann-Whitney test.

overall_summary: The overall risk of bias is high due to Domain 4 (measurement of the outcome), as subjective symptom improvement and otoscopic findings were assessed without blinding of participants, parents, or clinical examiners. Additional concerns exist regarding allocation concealment, post-randomization exclusions, and lack of a pre-registered analysis plan.

design_rationale: Participants were randomly assigned using a computer-generated table of random numbers.

domain_judgments.rationale: Although a computer-generated random sequence was generated, there is no mention of allocation concealment, and there was a substantial baseline difference in mean age between groups (4.28 vs 5.91 years).
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: A computer-generated table of random numbers was used for group assignment; if the last digit of the random number was from 0 to 4, assignment was to the 1st group (study group), and if the last digit was from 5 to 9, assignment was to the 2nd group (control group).

domain_judgments.rationale: The trial was open-label with no placebo nasal spray used in the control group, and no information is provided regarding protocol deviations or adherence.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: The 1st group was treated by mometasone furoate aqueous nasal spray 100 mcg/day (50 mcg/puff) 2 puffs per each nostril once daily for 1 month as well as amoxicillin–clavulanate 90 mg/kg/day for 4 weeks... The 2nd group was treated by amoxicillin–clavulanate 90 mg/kg/day for 4 weeks.

domain_judgments.rationale: Outcome data appear to be available for all 168 randomized participants across both follow-up time points with no reported attrition.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: One hundred sixty-eight children aged (4–12 years old) diagnosed with bilateral OME for at least 3 months were randomly allocated into two equal groups... First group N = 84, Second group N = 84

domain_judgments.rationale: Tympanometry and pure-tone audiometry are standardized, objective audiological measurements unlikely to be substantially influenced by knowledge of intervention status.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Follow-up was done after 2 and 4 weeks clinically and by tympanometry and audiometry.

domain_judgments.rationale: There is no mention of a pre-registered trial protocol or pre-specified statistical analysis plan to confirm outcomes and analyses were not selectively reported.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Statistical analysis Data collected were processed using the SPSS version 15 (SPSS Inc., Chicago, IL, USA). Chi-square test and t-test were used for comparison of tympanometric data and air-bone gap respectively.

overall_summary: The overall judgment is some concerns due to an unmentioned allocation concealment method alongside baseline age imbalance, an open-label unblinded design without placebo control, and the absence of a pre-registered protocol.
